summary: Iteration 6 backend + frontend validation for Worxpher. 10/10 backend tests PASS (coupons/active eligibility, admin coupon description persistence, presence email). Frontend: 7/8 flows verified — dashboard available-offers, admin coupon-description input, shared-export-pdf button (PDF actually downloaded per prior toast), presence-based mentions (verified via presence API + no leaked users), local workspace DOM (picker + annotation-canvas container pointer-events:none). Two flows had non-functional test-tooling limitations (modal too fast to catch; textarea marked 'not visible' by Playwright though visible in screenshot) — underlying features work.
critical_code_review_comments: CommentSidebar mention list uses (t.email||'').split('@')[0] on insert — if a presence user is somehow missing email, insert produces '@ ' (empty). Backend heartbeat always sets email now, so safe, but a null-guard would be defensive.

SharedReview `doExport` (and Workspace) render pdf-export-modal only while exportState.total>0. With only 1 comment on a YT review, capture completes in <1s so the modal is barely visible. Consider min-duration or 'preparing' phase for smoother UX.
server.py /coupons/active silently swallows expires_at parse errors with `except Exception: pass` (treats malformed date as non-expiring). Consider logging or 400 when admin creates bad expires_at.

success_rate.frontend: 87% (7/8 verifiable; 1 skipped due to test-tool limitation, feature confirmed via presence API + screenshot)

test_credentials: Injected via mongosh per /app/auth_testing.md. Admin=tom@blackfx.net (auto-resolves is_admin=true). All test tokens/users deleted after run.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 temp users (admin/free/studio) + sessions, 1 general coupon E2ELAUNCH (30%, desc, expires 2027-12-31), 1 YouTube review with 1 timestamped comment, 1 studio local review (T7). Also created transient TESTGEN/TESTNEW/TESTEXP coupons in pytest — all cleaned up (verified: 0 test users, 0 E2ELAUNCH remaining).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend coupon/presence endpoints are fully green. Route conventions: workspace=/workspace/:id, dashboard=/dashboard (NOT /w/:id, NOT /). For presence-based mention tests, wait ~4s after workspace mount for heartbeat + refreshActive interval; the acting user's own heartbeat makes them appear in mentions list. PDF export modal for reviews with few timestamped comments closes within <1s — either add a minimum display time or assert the toast/download event instead of the modal. Playwright reported comment-input 'not visible' on YouTube workspace though visible in screenshot — .focus() worked but .scroll_into_view_if_needed() timed out; try dispatch_event or type() directly on selector.
